en: Color postcard showing a dusk/night view of a modern seaside resort with illuminated high‑rise hotels and low villas around a lagoon or lake; a red sunset/moon is visible on the horizon. The back is in Romanian with a blue‑ink message, a Romanian stamp reading POSTA ROMANA 40b (A. Sisley – Biserica din Moret), postmarks including MANGALIA and BUCURESTI, and the printed caption identifying the place as VENUS (evening at Venus).
